summary: This bill allows nationals of the Czech Republic to be admitted into the United States as E1 nonimmigrant traders, provided that the Czech Republic offers similar nonimmigrant status to U.S. nationals.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the eligibility for E1 nonimmigrant visas to nationals of the Czech Republic, contingent on reciprocal treatment for U.S. nationals. This would allow more individuals from the Czech Republic to enter the U.S. for trade purposes, thus increasing a specific type of immigration.
